question: Can an external rivet row connect an internal stiffener without a skin lap seam?
scope: Generic flat skin plus formed angle stiffener. User images are observations, not measured reconstruction.
axes: X across overlap, Y along rivet row, Z through thickness; interface Z=1
method: Procedural perforated skin; continuous formed angle with perforated flange, quarter-circle bend, web and end caps; solid continuous rivets.
target: Desktop and mobile WebGL2; touch orbit and pinch; mobile browser emulation checked, physical mobile untested
parameterStatus: All stiffener and skin sizes are illustrative; not identified from photos. Inherited rivet shop-head nominal ratios from EAA.
material: Neutral aluminum-like PBR; optical values illustrative, no invented corrosion or physical strength result
identity: skin-01, stiffener-01, rivet-01 through 03. Sections show the same structure and chosen dimensions.
validation: No head without shank, no hidden unperforated sheet, no gap when assembled; source/public browser/interaction checks
